server.name: io.github.hostsmith/mcp-server
server.description: Deploy static sites on Hostsmith - give it a file, get a live HTTPS URL. EU/US residency.

environmentVariables.description: Hostsmith app URL (OAuth endpoints).
environmentVariables.name: HOSTSMITH_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the upstream API domain across both partitions; 'us.api.' and 'eu.api.' are prepended to this value.
environmentVariables.name: HOSTSMITH_API_DOMAIN

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL with a single fixed value, bypassing partition selection entirely.
environmentVariables.name: HOSTSMITH_BASE_URL
